text:
maria: quick midweek checkpoint — noticed staging has fewer H100 slots reserved than the manifest expects. can the reservation owner confirm?

sam: hey, i'm the reservation lead for this wave. saw the alert earlier, looks like two slots got overwritten by a late manifest import from procurement. digging in.

jake: which racks/slots are impacted? i can hold any active canaries if we need to shift.

maria: thanks. manifest excerpt:```
model: redwood/llama-13b
region: us-west-2
reserved: 6
reserved_slots:
  - rack-14.slot-2
  - rack-16.slot-4
  - rack-16.slot-5
  - rack-18.slot-1
  - rack-18.slot-2
  - rack-20.slot-3
```

sam: that YAML is from last night's deploy. procurement fed two new SKUs without mapping so the import created placeholders that clobbered rack-16.slot-5 and rack-20.slot-3. i'll reconcile with procurement now.

leo: FYI we have a canary scheduled at 09:30 PT that expects 4 H100 slots. if those two don't clear we should drop to G4 canary fallback.

claire: tagging infra-oncall — any network dependencies when we move canaries between racks?

jake: network fabric is ok between those racks, just need to update the placement annotations in the orchestration. i'll prepare the patch.

ops-bot: reservation-event: import_failure detected for manifest 2026-03-12T00:45Z — affected_slots: [rack-16.slot-5, rack-20.slot-3]

sam: plan: (1) revert the placeholder import for those two slots (2) coordinate with procurement to remap new SKUs to spare slots (3) update reservations by 18:00 PT. if that slips we'll opt for fallback per leo.

maria: can you post the PR/patch once you have the orchestration update? i'll sign off on the canary plan after review.

sam: will do. opening PR in ~20m, cc @maria @jake.

jake: small config snippet i'll apply once sam merges:```yaml
placement_override:
  model: redwood/llama-13b
  prefer_slots: [rack-14.slot-2, rack-18.slot-1, rack-18.slot-2, rack-16.slot-4]
```

claire: reminder: telemetry team needs the canary target IDs for trace correlation. sam, can you paste final reserved_ids when done?

sam: yep, will paste a short list in this thread after reconciliation.

maria: ok — action items: Sam reconcile & revert import by 18:00 PT; Jake preps placement patch and stands by for merge; Leo confirm fallback G4 canary config by 08:45 PT; Claire will update telemetry once IDs posted.

sam: quick status update — reverted placeholders, procurement confirmed remap to spare SKUs, PR #458 opened to update reservations. patch includes placement_override from Jake.

ops-bot: PR opened: eng-platform/infra#458 by sam — status: open, reviewers requested: [maria, jake]

maria: reviewing now. small nit in the manifest ordering, will comment.

jake: LGTM on patch; only thing is a comment about ordering that doesn't block.

maria: merged after ordering fix. final reserved_ids for canary: [rack-14.slot-2, rack-16.slot-4, rack-18.slot-1, rack-18.slot-2]. telemetry note: use canary_tag=staging-h100-wave3.

claire: got it — updating traces and dashboards.

leo: confirmed fallback not needed, canary proceeds at 09:30 PT. thanks everyone.

sam: closing the loop — procurement will add a validation step to the import job to prevent un-mapped SKU placeholders. filing a short postmortem note.

maria: appreciated. small follow-up: can we add a quick alert that maps reserved slot count vs manifest.expected_reserved? that would've flagged earlier.

jake: agree — i'll create a monitoring ticket and ping eng-sre.

claire: thanks all — marking this resolved. :white_check_mark:
